accepted_claims: The proposal preserves the governed whole-expression reading of the bar and does not reduce it to division, ratio, punctuation, tuple construction, or subtraction.
The proposal preserves order sensitivity as a requirement rather than erasing operand order.
The proposal treats a domain value as a projection rather than an identity with the RT atom.
The proposal remains appropriately capped at C1_DEFINED_PROVISIONAL and disclaims theorem-level Euclidean/Pythagorean claims.
The target chain is directionally aligned with the existing projection route from distinction/deviation toward geometry, subject to missing formal gates.
rejected_claims: The claim that (2|4) is already a closed Atom_RT is not accepted as currently defined.
The claim Pi_Euclid((2|4)_RT)=a is not accepted as a defined projection law.
The claim that (2|4) realizes the whole truth of Asym is not accepted without typed references, closure, and evaluation rules.
Any scalarization of 2 and 4 is rejected unless separately declared as the projection map.
required_repairs: Add a provisional typed closure/Atom_RT contract to the induction registry, not the canonical theorem layer.
Resolve alpha notation collision before using alpha_L/alpha_R.
Register operand/reference types and define <S>, >S< or replace them with governed syntax.
Define Pi_Euclid: Atom_RT -> Length_Euclid with units/normalization, invariants, reversal behavior, and uniqueness/family status.
Run the proposed type, projection candidate, reversal, degeneracy, and triangle-antecedent validation phases.
Keep the textbook addition provisional and add it only after human approval with exact patch locations.
